targets.title: Brain drain: The mere presence of one’s own smartphone reduces available cognitive capacity.
targets.evidence_quote:
The present study was a pre-registered direct replication of Ward et al.’s (2017) second
experiment (OSF pre-registration found at: https://osf.io/5fq4r).
targets.outcome_quote:
Using the same tasks and conditions as in Ward et al.’s (2017) second experiment,
the present study found that the “brain drain” effect did not replicate: there was no difference
between smartphone location conditions on performance on either the o-span task or the
go/no-go task.
